subject: Virtua Cop 2 (JPN, HDR-0061): its IP.BIN bootstrap 2 and K-UI's CD music pool
derived_metadata_only: No disc, kernel or bootstrap bytes. Addresses are P1 unless marked P2.

ip_bin.source: the owner's GDI image (private, not distributed)

inputs.reference_bootstrap: Bust-A-Move 4 (US, T-8117N) IP.BIN, the standard bootstrap

evidence_kinds.original_backed_host_execution: The disc's bootstrap 2 run from K-UI's entry state (PC 0xac00e000, r15 0x8c00f400, SR 0x600000f0) to the game entry 0xac010000 by a scratch SH-4 integer interpreter (not committed). The same interpreter on Bust-A-Move 4's IP.BIN writes only the standard 0x8c00fc00..0x8c010000 clear.
evidence_kinds.authored_model: The BIOS FLASHROM syscall (0x8c0000b8) on a 128 KiB flash with KOS partition geometry; flash states: blank, headers present, repeat boots on the flash the previous boot left, and a synthesized near-full partition 3. The BIOS routines' own stack frames are not modelled.
evidence_kinds.static_comparison: IP 0x300..0x6000 matches Bust-A-Move 4's except the area-protection text at 0x3704..0x3737; the bootstrap 2 header and opening match the standard; its high-RAM literals in 0x6000..0x7fff are 0xacfc0000 (twice), 0xacfd0000, 0xacfe0000 and 0xacff0000.
evidence_kinds.stage_crc: The stage's own CRC routine (src/loader/stage_fast_crc32.h, host build) gives 0x3f7f1c3d on the IP.BIN, equal to zlib CRC32.
evidence_kinds.linked_admission: test-wince-packaged-prepare --bam4-kernel with this kernel and module build 1ac7e667c0d3, raw and 2048-byte DATA: pass.
evidence_kinds.console: Module 9e89e778370f, GUI 1c71ba3afa17, CD music On (owner, 21 Nov 2026): BOOTSTRAP ALTERED STREAM SOURCE MAP, DETAIL 0. Module 1ac7e667c0d3, CD music On (owner, 21 Nov 2026): the repair works; Windows CE starts and the game passes its memory-card check, then the reader stops on GD function 6, a stream piece into video memory (docs/evidence/wince-cdda-vc2-vram-2026-11-22.json). Module 949be40865cf, which keeps this repair, CD music On (owner, 22 Nov 2026): ran perfectly.

bootstrap.entered_at: IP+0x6000 (P2 0xac00e000); the lower IP code is not run
bootstrap.program: Sega play-history recorder AIPf 1.07 over the Katana flash manager fmMng 1.04
changes_from_standard: after the cache is disabled: a check call, then the recorder, with r4 0xacfd0000, r5 0xacfc0000, r6 0xacfe0000, r7 0xacff0000
bootstrap.flash: partition 2 header check; partition 4 state marker (SEGA_FH01 two-phase update); partition 3 product, title and counter/RTC blocks, compacted when full
bootstrap.registers_to_game: standard apart from FPSCR; nothing passed in registers

ram_writes.what: fmMng block buffer (0x8c00fce0) and variables; zeroed by the standard tail before the game entry
stack, normal boot (700 bytes), every modelled flash state

ram_writes.range: below the lowest caller SP (about 0x8cfbfd4c, or 0x8cfbfd10 on compaction)

ram_writes.what: 60 bytes of the recorder's work data (r5)
r4 buffer, cleared whole and filled every boot
r6 buffer, compaction path only (could reach 0x8cff0000)

controller_and_zero_tail.note: BIOS frames would need more than about 3.3 KiB below the recorder's lowest frame to reach it; the relay's check of it passed on the console

work_page.note: not checked by the non-VMU relay; a transport destination only

stage_stack.note: dead during bootstrap 2; the resume path reloads 0x8cff0000

other_layouts_inside_the_window: the combined CD music and VMU spill at 0x8cfc0000 (2 KiB), checked as BOOTSTRAP ALTERED CE DATA SPILL
a unified pool of 64 KiB or more below RAM end 0x8cfd0000 (roadmap F8)
the VMU worker and lease area at 0x8cfd0000 in other modules

fix.gate: IP CRC32 0x3f7f1c3d, already checked by the stage against the loaded IP.BIN
fix.action: after bootstrap 2, before the relay: reinstall the 4 KiB map from the stage's proven copy and zero the 64 KiB work and guard pages
fix.refusal: BOOTSTRAP 2 SCRATCH COPY REFUSED, DETAIL 3..8 (seed header, map CRC word, decode, runtime policy, map mismatch, copy readback)

limits: The BIOS FLASHROM frames were not modelled; a frame below 0x8cfbf000 would still stop the launch at the controller check.
Another pressing or region of Virtua Cop 2 (another IP.BIN) keeps round 2's stop until examined.
No survey of every WinCE disc's bootstrap 2 for top-of-RAM use exists.
One console run of the fix (21 Nov 2026), which ended at the next stop; a second cold boot was not reported.
